decision.reason: The user approved a plan to cut rc.36 without a benchmark round and asked for it to be done overnight, so the benefit-led npm README and description and the catalog manifests with the published 61-PR results (#159) reach npm and the plugin catalogs, and so the first release with release candidates on npm's latest tag and the MCP Registry waiting for npm (#158) runs end to end. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
